mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high labor market tightness regime (UNRATE below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly), rising wage pressures increase inflation expectations and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with rising INDPRO over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with HOUST < 2000 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS above 360,000 and HOUST above 2100), overvaluation and profit-taking pressures cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with RSAFS > 360,000 and HOUST > 2100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals aggressive monetary policy amid labor market strength, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
